name: usage-ledger-authority-evidence
title: LLM usage ledger Touchpoint 6 (local slice): privacy-preserving usage-evidence envelope + receipt-reference fields + pluggable verification gate (stays receiptVerified=false locally)
description: Authority slice (spec Touchpoint 6 'Authority Server Receipt-Backed Path' + 'Local Non-authority Boundary'), scoped to the LOCAL, server-independent part only. No Authority Server is required to exist. Deliverables, all inside the usage-ledger module (preserving zero cross-module imports via a PLUGGABLE verifier interface — do NOT import the authority-signing module): (1) a privacy-preserving usage-evidence ENVELOPE shape + builder that encodes a ledger record as digests + non-secret fields needed for a future Authority Server submission (no raw prompt/transcript/secret/key — reuse the existing privacy denylist); (2) receipt-reference fields on the record's authority block (receiptId nullable, receiptSubjectKind, receiptSubjectId) kept nullable; (3) a verification GATE: verifyUsageReceipt(envelope, signedReceipt, verifyFn) that sets authority.receiptVerified=true and binds receiptId ONLY when an injected verifyFn confirms a real signed receipt AND subject binding matches; otherwise receiptVerified stays false. The local append path NEVER sets receiptVerified=true on its own. (4) Negative controls (per spec): transport acceptance is not proof; a provider response with real tokens is not proof; a local JSONL hash is not proof; a copied receiptId without signature+subject verification is not proof — all must keep receiptVerified=false. (5) A smoke. Out of scope: the Authority Server itself, network submission, real signature crypto (the verifier is injected/pluggable), promoting any local record to receipt-backed authority by default.
